en.bdb: Akk - a plant of sandy region. Grass hopper,leech and the Manmukh

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਲੈ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਰਸ ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸੁਹੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: van vich falai vanaasapat bahu ras ga(n)dh suga(n)dh suha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: In the forest adorns the vegetation of variegated colours.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬ ਸਦਾ ਫਲ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਆੜੂ ਸੇਵ ਅਨਾਰ ਫਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)b sadhaa fal sohane aaRoo sev anaar fala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Mango is always considered a nice fruit and so is the peach, apple, pomegranate etc. which grows on trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਖ ਬਿਜਉਰੀ ਜਾਮਣੂ ਖਿਰਣੀ ਤੂਤ ਖਜੂਰਿ ਅਨੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhaakh bijauree jaamanoo khiranee toot khajoor ana(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Lemon sized grapes, plums, mimosaceous, mulberry, dates etc. all are delight giving fruits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਲੂ ਪੇਝੂ ਬੇਰ ਬਹੁ ਕੇਲੇ ਤੇ ਅਖਰੋਟ ਬਣੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: peeloo pejhoo ber bahu kele te akharoT bana(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Pilu, pejhu, ber, walnut, bananas, (all small and big Indian fruits) also grow on (Indian) trees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਅਕਟਿਡਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਤਜਿ ਅਕਿ ਵਸੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: mool na bhaavan akaTidd a(n)mirat fal taj ak vasa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: But the grasshopper does not like them all and jumps to sit on akk, the wild plant of sandy region.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਥਣ ਜੋਕ ਲਵਾਈਐ ਦੁਧ ਨ ਪੀਐ ਲੋਹੂ ਗੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: je than jok lavaieeaai dhudh na peeaai lohoo ga(n)dhe|

en.bdb: If a leech is put on the teat of cow or buffalo, it will suck impure blood and not milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗਣਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਝਾਖ ਝਖੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun ganatee a(n)dhar jhaakh jhakha(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Even after listening to the Word of the Guru in the holy congregation those who toss between the feelings of loss and profit.
Their false love cannot reach any place.
